DATA & COVERAGE

Confidence should be visible.

AccessPath uses your supplied VT pilot dataset. Route geometry and accessibility are provisional; the app is not ready for real navigation.

No path accessibility has been verified.

Building coordinates attributed to VT do not confirm entrance positions, step-free access, building hours, or elevator availability. Entrance locations are placeholders in the supplied data.

What you can do here

Compare approximate routes, inspect historical floorplans, and simulate closures. Strict access settings return no route when the evidence is missing. Cross-floor shortcuts remain excluded until their connections are mapped.

Imported status records

These are records supplied in the ZIP, not a live Facilities feed. Future and expired reports are handled separately. A closure ending does not verify that an asset reopened.

Sources

AccessPath VT pilot ZIP and workbook, version 0.3.0-scaffold. Floorplans: supplied CDCD archive dated September 7, 2006. This pilot remains private; archive reuse terms have not been established.
